title: The Fidelity Frontier in Computational Psychiatry: Quantifying Psychopathology Without Collapsing Lived Experience
domain: computational psychiatry / phenomenological psychopathology / neurophenomenology / psychometrics / digital mental health
summary: A methodology program for quantifying psychopathology while explicitly measuring information lost when rich first-person experience is compressed into phenomenological codes, symptom scales, computational parameters, or diagnoses. It introduces a multi-axis fidelity frontier, preserves raw evidence as an immutable source layer, and separates phenomenological fidelity from construct validity, biological concordance, prediction, and acquisition burden.
